title: mail-server SieveScript history (feature sieve), register_sieve_handlers_with_history
description:
Design: docs/design/object-history.md. Decisions: docs/design/DECISIONS.md.
Note key: H6. Crates: jmap-mail-types, jmap-mail-server (feature sieve). Size: S.

Spec: object-history-03 §5.2 (SieveScript comes back inactive; activate with onSuccessActivateScript; name clash ⇒ alreadyExists), §3, §4. Design: docs/design/object-history.md §5 'Registration', §9 'Existing crates'.

Work:
- impl HistoryObject for SieveScript.
- History get/set handlers. Bind `using` from CallContext, because Sieve is registered without it.
- Destroyed query: SieveScript has no QueryObject and filters in the handler, so use get_object_history(ids: None, include_destroyed) plus the same handler-side filter and paging.
- A restored script id is a valid onSuccessActivateScript target in the same call.
- register_sieve_handlers_with_history.
- Memory records script versions.

This bead runs after H5 because it shares mail-server lib.rs and memory/mod.rs.

Acceptance:
- Restore ⇒ isActive false.
- Name clash ⇒ alreadyExists.
- Restore + onSuccessActivateScript of the same id activates it.
- Destroyed query filtering and paging work.
- CHANGELOG bullet, public-api.
